policy.threshold_source: frozen training q99 per-channel sample changes
policy.flag: abs(x[t,c] - x[t-1,c]) > threshold[c]; equality unflagged; first segment row False
policy.causality: Labels use truth only for offline scoring; never supplied to predictors
policy.scope: All 102 validation segments and four frozen regimes; six unchanged MLPs and LOCF
policy.interpretation: Other is the complementary group, not necessarily quiet motion; labels do not diagnose motion or faults
policy.replay_checks: Single full replay per case, match all saved overall sums/counts; previous full causal audits remain applicable because sources/checkpoints are unchanged
policy.additional_checks: All flags checked by scalar differences; hidden-label mutation isolation on segment82/random for every predictor

limits: One validation subject with synthetic losses
No tuning, uncertainty calibration, or INT8 deployment
Post-hoc truth labels cannot serve as online abstention inputs
Seed spread is not cross-subject uncertainty
